About CM Services

Reliable Engineering. Professional Service.

When a machine breaks down, the cost is never just the repair. Work stops, schedules slip, and every idle hour is money lost. Dependable servicing is what keeps that from happening — machinery that is looked after properly works harder, lasts longer and lets you down less.

CM Services provides professional heavy plant servicing and repairs built around that simple idea: quality workmanship, straightforward communication, and a clear focus on reducing unnecessary downtime for the businesses that rely on their machinery.

  • Servicing and repairs across a wide range of heavy plant
  • Quality workmanship on every job, large or small
  • Clear, straightforward communication from enquiry to completion
  • Focused on reducing unnecessary downtime for your business
